Metal Burst.name: Metal Burst
Metal Burst.short_desc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5x damage.

Thrash.name: Thrash
Thrash.short_desc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

Acupressure.name: Acupressure
Acupressure.short_desc: Raises a random stat of the user or an ally by 2.

Bubble Beam.name: Bubble Beam
Bubble Beam.short_desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

Memento.name: Memento
Memento.short_desc: Lowers target's Attack, Sp. Atk by 2. User faints.

Recover.name: Recover
Recover.short_desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

Spikes.name: Spikes
Spikes.short_desc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

Supercell Slam.name: Supercell Slam
Supercell Slam.short_desc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.

Zing Zap.name: Zing Zap
Zing Zap.short_desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

After You.name: After You
After You.short_desc: The target makes its move right after the user.

Aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
Aromatherapy.short_desc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

Extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
Extrasensory.short_desc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.

Healing Wish.name: Healing Wish
Healing Wish.short_desc: User faints. Next hurt Pokemon is fully healed.

Imprison.name: Imprison
Imprison.short_desc: No foe can use any move known by the user.

Terrain Pulse.name: Terrain Pulse
Terrain Pulse.short_desc: User on terrain: power doubles, type varies.

Follow Me.name: Follow Me
Follow Me.short_desc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.

Guard Split.name: Guard Split
Guard Split.short_desc: Averages Defense and Sp. Def stats with target.

Psycho Shift.name: Psycho Shift
Psycho Shift.short_desc: Transfers the user's status ailment to the target.

Absorb.name: Absorb
Absorb.short_desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

Earth Power.name: Earth Power
Earth Power.short_desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Mega Drain.name: Mega Drain
Mega Drain.short_desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

Petal Blizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
Petal Blizzard.short_desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

Petal Dance.name: Petal Dance
Petal Dance.short_desc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

Pollen Puff.name: Pollen Puff
Pollen Puff.short_desc: If the target is an ally, heals 50% of its max HP.

Strength Sap.name: Strength Sap
Strength Sap.short_desc: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.

Double Shock.name: Double Shock
Double Shock.short_desc: User's Electric type: typeless; must be Electric.

Entrainment.name: Entrainment
Entrainment.short_desc: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.

Revival Blessing.name: Revival Blessing
Revival Blessing.short_desc: Revives a fainted Pokemon to 50% HP.

Rock Tomb.name: Rock Tomb
Rock Tomb.short_desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

Upper Hand.name: Upper Hand
Upper Hand.short_desc: 100% flinch. Fails unless target using priority attack.

Hurricane.name: Hurricane
Hurricane.short_desc: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.short_desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

Tailwind.name: Tailwind
Tailwind.short_desc: For 4 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.

Comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
Comeuppance.short_desc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5x damage.

Jaw Lock.name: Jaw Lock
Jaw Lock.short_desc: Prevents both user and target from switching out.

Outrage.name: Outrage
Outrage.short_desc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

Psychic Fangs.name: Psychic Fangs
Psychic Fangs.short_desc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.
